conclusion: The documented canonical reference (mode D) is a per-frame frame-aligned counterfactual that cannot be deployed outside simulation. The mode the live adapter actually used for the headline condition (mode B) is deployable but is a new, unvalidated controller that no committed source or paper text establishes. Mode A is the only reference-free option whose input distribution matches Safety-CVAE training. Choosing between these is a scientific scope decision, not an implementation detail, so it is escalated rather than decided here.
